scoring_justification: The scored artifact is a post-processed CSV of crack lengths. Recomputing from raw simulation fields is not feasible because the agent submits only the final lengths. The checker compares reported values to paper-derived gold values with tolerance and verifies the ordering trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold crack lengths at t=6 s
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'crack lengths are increased 22.79% … for isotropic models, and 17.18% … for hybrid models … for initial crack lengths of 60 nm.'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from paper's reported percentage increases; rounding consistent.

outputs.description: Crack length evolution from t=0 to t=6 s for the baseline case. The checker will verify that at t=6 s, hybrid_crack_length_nm < isotropic_crack_length_nm (ordering), and compare the reported isotropic and hybrid crack lengths at t=6 s against hidden paper-derived reference values with an appropriate tolerance.

steps.description: File exists, correct columns, contains rows for t=0 and t=6.
At t=6 s, hybrid_crack_length_nm must be strictly less than isotropic_crack_length_nm.
Isotropic and hybrid crack lengths at t=6 s must match paper-derived gold (73.674 nm, 70.308 nm) within 5% relative tolerance; scoring is monotonic with error.
